description: This file defines a report for item shortages in stock, including functions to generate report columns, fetch data with SQL queries, and prepare chart data for visualization.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns, data, and chart data based on filters.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Constructs SQL conditions based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches stock bin data with SQL query, filtering for negative projected quantities.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares chart data (labels and values) for visualization, limiting to top 10 items.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the stock shortage report.
